messages.subject: Introduction to Distance Sampling
parts:
Following up on my earlier message, the UK office of OUP are offering 15%
discount on 'Introduction to Distance Sampling' to members of the distance
sampling list. Unfortunately, they are not permitted to sell to anyone in
North America or Australasia, but anyone else can obtain the discount
order form from http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distancebook/newbook.html.
Note that there is a p&p charge, as detailed on the form.

Steve Buckland
